crew.overview: One day a young woman named Blanca is saved by Xuan, a snake catcher from a nearby village. She has lost her memory, and together they go on a journey to discover her real identity, developing deeper feelings for one another along the way. But as they learn more about her past, they uncover a darker plot of supernatural forces vying for power, with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.
crew.title: White Snake

details.biography: Huang Hai designs posters for films. He has worked in several well known films. He was born in 1976 in Fujian.
details.name: Huang Hai
